label: SYNTHETIC
description: Closure + null tests for 2D transverse topology

negative_control.note: sigma here is the BASELINE OFFSET of an undeformed field against its own shuffle null. It is not a deformation response. A large value does not fail this test (the test only bars >= 5 sigma) but it is exactly the quantity that E2.11 requires be subtracted before any Delta-sigma is quoted.

null_fpr.note: nominal alpha is derived from the sigma threshold actually applied (two-sided Gaussian tail), not declared independently of it. If the null bank takes few distinct values the Gaussian interpretation of sigma is invalid and a failure here should be read as that, not as a broken null.
